summary: Preserve privacy-safe field briefings and identification workflows while redacting coordinate and private response fields at the transport boundary.
reason: iNaturalist responses can contain obscured, private, or geometry-bearing location data; catalog commands must never emit, cache, or persist those fields while still retaining geoprivacy and obscured-state labels.
validated_outcome: Privacy-redaction unit test, live novel-feature check (5/5), dogfood, verify, and shipcheck passed without emitting coordinates.
